evidence.title: Sign Up Form · React motion component · beUI

name: Sign Up Form
summary: Composed sign-up form block for React and Next.js with inline validation, a password strength meter and animated submit states.
description: A copy-paste sign-up form with name, email, password and confirm-password fields, a terms checkbox and a submit button that follows the form lifecycle. A field is flagged only once it is left and cleared the moment it is fixed; the length-weighted strength meter, password reveal and loading, success and error states are built in. Install with the shadcn CLI or copy the TSX source.
contains: sign-up form block with name, email, password and confirm password fields
validation flags a field after it is left and clears it when fixed
length-weighted password strength meter and password reveal
animated submit lifecycle: loading, success and error
installs with the shadcn CLI or by copying the TSX source
